articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Johnson & Johnson’s Myeloma Approval And What It May Mean For JNJ Stock. Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) received FDA approval for DARZALEX FASPRO in combination with D-VRd. The regimen is approved for adult patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma who are ineligible for autologous stem cell transplant. This decision expands treatment options for a specific group of multiple myeloma patients.
